entries.title: Noord-Korea vuurt ballistische raketten richting zee na militaire oefening VS
entries.paragraph_1: NOORD-KOREA - Noord-Korea heeft zaterdag een aantal ballistische raketten richting zee afgevuurd. Dat gebeurde na een militaire oefening van de Verenigde Staten, Japan...
entries.paragraph_2: en Zuid-Korea. Zuid-Koreaanse strijdkrachten detecteerden meerdere raketten die vanuit buurland Noord-Korea in de richting van de Japanse Zee werden afgevuurd. Het ging om ballistische korteafstandsraketten. De Zuid-Koreaanse veiligheidsraad heeft de raketlanceringen in een verklaring veroordeeld. Het afvuren van ballistische raketten is volgens Seoel in strijd met VN-resoluties. Zuid-Korea voerde de afgelopen dagen samen met de Verenigde Staten en Japan militaire oefeningen in de regio uit. Het land staat in nauw contact met de Amerikanen, die aangaven dat het incident geen direct gevaar vormt voor de VS of zijn bondgenoten. De militaire oefeningen waren volgens Zuid-Korea defensief van aard. Noord-Korea gaf eerder deze week al aan dat het de oefeningen als "provocerend" beschouwt. Pyongyang vuurt wel vaker ballistische raketten richting zee af om omliggende westerse landen af te schrikken. Onlangs leek de Amerikaanse president Donald Trump toenadering te zoeken tot Kim Jong-un. Trump schaalde militaire oefeningen met Zuid-Korea af, vermoedelijk om bij de Noord-Koreaanse dictator in het gevlei te komen. De Amerikaanse president zei vorige maand "een goede relatie" met Kim te hebben en zinspeelde op een bezoek aan Pyongyang. Daar is het nog niet van gekomen . (NU)

entries.title: North Korea Won’t Give Up Nuclear Weapons, Kim’s Sister Says
entries.paragraph_1: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, Kim Yo Jong, has declared that the country’s status as a nuclear-armed state is “absolute,” dismissing hopes that Pyongyang could eventually surrender its nuclear weapons. Kim Yo Jong made the remarks on Thursday, insisting that North Korea’s nuclear status was permanent and could not be reversed through diplomatic pressure. North Korea has legally established itself as a nuclear weapons state, with its leadership maintaining that its nuclear arsenal is permanent and irreversible. Advertisement US President Donald Trump said in August that North Korea possessed 57 “very powerful” nuclear weapons, while South Korea has estimated the country’s arsenal at between 80 and 120 warheads. Kim Yo Jong’s comments came as South Korea said it was closely monitoring developments, particularly because Trump has recently raised the possibility of another meeting with Kim Jong Un. “The DPRK’s position as a nuclear weapons state is absolute which can not reverse with anything,” Kim Yo Jong said in a statement carried by the official Korean Central News Agency. Advertisement She argued that North Korea’s nuclear arsenal plays an important role in deterring what she described as hostile actions by other countries. Pyongyang’s nuclear weapons, she said, “makes a significant contribution to deterring the outrageous acts of international rogues.” Her remarks came during the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) in Vienna, where she also dismissed renewed discussions about denuclearising North Korea. Advertisement Kim Yo Jong said the “familiar silly talk” about efforts to denuclearise the country was expected. “If they believe that it is really possible, they will only hear the word of idiots,” she said. She further insisted that neither political statements nor international opposition could alter North Korea’s nuclear status. Advertisement “No matter how rhetorically the hostile forces may deny, the reality in which the nuclear position of the DPRK has been permanently settled physically and legally cannot change even a bit,” she added, using the acronym for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, North Korea’s official name. A South Korean Unification Ministry official said Kim Yo Jong’s statement was significant because of its timing, coming amid renewed discussion about US-North Korea diplomacy. “We are paying close attention to Kim Yo Jong’s statement, as it comes at a time when US President Donald Trump has recently expressed his willingness to pursue dialogue with North Korea,” the official said, according to a transcript obtained by AFP. Advertisement Trump has repeatedly said he is open to restarting talks with Kim Jong Un and said last month that he planned to meet the North Korean leader later this year. Trump and Kim met three times during Trump’s first term, but their diplomatic engagement stalled following the 2019 summit in Hanoi. The Hanoi meeting ended without an agreement on sanctions relief or what North Korea would provide in return for denuclearisation. Advertisement Since the collapse of those talks, Pyongyang has continued expanding its nuclear arsenal. Opinion Nigeria News Advertisement

[Column] An open letter to Kim Jong-un and Donald Trump
entries.paragraph_1: Greetings. My name is Cheong Wook-sik, and I have worked to promote peace on the Korean Peninsula for 27 years. In this open letter, I want to send my regards to Kim Jong-un, chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers’ Party of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and President Donald Trump of the United States of America.
entries.paragraph_2: As you are both aware, all eyes are on a potential North Korea-US summit. The public in South Korea as well as the Lee administration in Seoul are hoping that this meeting takes place as a major step toward peace on the peninsula and the world at large. My hope is that the proposed talks become a major milestone in officially ending the Korean War, which has technically lasted for over 76 years.

entries.paragraph_2: When Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates SEMICON India 2026 on September 17, the fifth edition of this showcase will unfold as the country’s most consequential semiconductor gathering yet - with more than 600 exhibitors, roughly 300 from abroad, six country pavilions, a dozen state pavilions and more than 150 speakers, all under the theme “Silicon to Systems”. entries.title: Beef Export Value Strong while Pork Exports below Year-Ago - Southeast AgNET
entries.paragraph_1: U.S. beef exports delivered another strong month in July, according to data released by the USDA and compiled by the U.S. Meat Export Federation . Export volume held steady at just over 89,000 metric tons, while export value climbed 6% from a year ago to nearly $797 million. Strong demand from Taiwan, Mexico, Japan, the Middle East, Colombia, the Caribbean, and Southeast Asia helped drive those gains.
entries.paragraph_2: USMEF President and CEO Dan Halstrom says global demand for U.S. beef remains resilient despite ongoing challenges in China. While exports in China remain well below previous years’ levels, growth in other international markets continue to support overall beef demand. For the first seven months of the year, beef exports totaled nearly 635,000 metric tons, valued at $5.5 billion.

entries.paragraph_2: Në një intervistë për transmetuesin japonez NHK, Zelenskyy tha se kompanitë japoneze mund të përfitojnë nga përvoja e Ukrainës në mbikëqyrjen detare, zbulimin, çminimin, mbrojtjen ajrore dhe sigurinë kibernetike. “Ne dëshirojmë shumë të ndërtojmë bashkëpunim ushtarako-teknologjik midis Ukrainës dhe Japonisë”, tha ai duke shprehur interes për partneritete si në nivel qeveritar, ashtu edhe në atë të biznesit.

entries.title: Бракът Путин-Ким Чен-ун обърка сметките на Си Цзинпин - Свят — Новини Стандарт
entries.paragraph_1: Един от най-неочакваните геополитически ефекти на войната в Украйна започва да се усеща не в Европа, а на другия край на Евразия. Задълбочаващото се военно партньорство между Владимир Путин и Ким Чен-ун дава на Северна Корея пари, технологии и политическа свобода, каквито режимът в Пхенян не е имал от години, а това все повече тревожи Китай. Според анализ на „Форбс“ проблемът за Пекин е двоен - Си Цзинпин рискува да загуби част от традиционното си влияние върху Ким, докато една по-силна и по-самоуверена Северна Корея може да направи целия регион значително по-опасен.
entries.paragraph_2: Русия плаща огромна цена за продължителната война в Украйна. Разходите на Москва се оценяват на приблизително 290 млрд. долара годишно и тя има загуби от около 30 000 военнослужещи месечно. Руското настъпление е спряло или се забавя по отделни направления, а икономическата тежест на конфликта все по-силно достига до населението.

entries.title: Revenge Strikes: Russia Targets Ukrainian Gas Stations With Drones
entries.paragraph_1: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) – Russian drones targeted roadside gas stations in Kyiv for a second straight day Friday, as Moscow broadened its air war in what Ukrainian officials say is an effort to rattle civilians.
entries.paragraph_2: Russian strikes on urban gas stations have intensified in recent months, mostly in regions near the front line in eastern and southern Ukraine. It is part of a campaign to disrupt civilian life and weaken morale that has also included attacks on food distribution hubs, sporadically leaving some supermarket shelves bare in the Ukrainian capital.

entries.title: Načelnik Generalštaba britanske vojske: U Ukrajini poginulo više od pola miliona ruskih vojnika :: Ukrajina :: RTCG - Radio Televizija Crne Gore - Nacionalni javni servis
entries.paragraph_1: Više od pola miliona ruskih vojnika poginulo je u Ukrajini od ruske invazije u februaru 2022. godine, izjavio je danas načelnik Generalštaba odbrane Velike Britanije.
entries.paragraph_2: Maršal vazduhoplovstva ser Ričard Najton rekao je da je taj broj poginulih dio ukupno 1,5 miliona vojnika Rusije izbačenih iz stroja u Ukrajini.
